title: IDM
tagline: Detailed electronic music built for curious listening as much as dancing.
summary: IDM, short for intelligent dance music, became a label for experimental electronic releases that drew on techno, ambient, and breakbeat while emphasizing intricate production. The term is debated by artists and listeners, but it describes a body of adventurous work that expanded electronic music's rhythmic and textural possibilities.

pillars.name: Aphex Twin
pillars.why: Aphex Twin's releases move between intricate rhythms, ambient passages, and unpredictable electronic sound design.

pillars.name: Autechre
pillars.why: Autechre continually explored complex programming and abstract structures within electronic music.

pillars.name: Boards of Canada
pillars.why: Boards of Canada paired textured electronics with hazy melodies and distinctive, nostalgic production.
